strings.title: Backgammon (Declarative)
strings.die_half_used: Die {n}: {value}, one of two moves used
strings.help_select: Select a green checker, then a green destination.
strings.help_dice: Use both dice; doubles give four moves.
strings.help_hit: Hit a lone opponent. Two opponents block a point.
strings.help_bar: Return captured checkers from the bar first.
strings.help_home: Bring all 15 home, then bear off. First off wins.
